fusions.name: Every Wound Counted
fusions.desc: Sends a dart of darkness into the first enemy in its path for 18 dark damage, using up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage per affliction. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Scanning Sweep
fusions.desc: A sweep of clicks 4 tiles ahead of you deals 6 resonating damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Pinning Stare
fusions.desc: A fixed stare and a shriek hold every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Two Kinds of Sight
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
